heading.prefix: The only booking system that messages clients for you,

description: While other platforms charge you per text message, AgenditApp automates confirmations, reminders, and campaigns — sent straight from your own WhatsApp Business number. It's one of the highest open-rate channels out there, and most scheduling tools don't offer it at all.
